name: Ame Yori Terasu Tokoshie no Kami
source:
"Humans and youkai should live equally."

A god who suddenly disappeared a thousand years ago. In the past, he was invisible to the human eye, but humans and youkai were both certain of his existence.

He still hides his face while he appears in Mashiro's dreams searching for the "soul of Kamui."

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_kami.png]official website[/url]]

One of Mashiro's love interests.
